fun_facts: Jake Elliott grew up in Western Springs, Illinois, and played tennis and soccer.
He didn't start playing organized football until his junior year of high school.
At Memphis, he earned first-team All-Conference honors in all four of his seasons.
He set a Memphis school record with a 56-yard field goal.
He finished college with American Athletic Conference career records for points (445) and made field goals (81).
In 2017, he made a 61-yard game-winning field goal that was the longest in Eagles history.

basis.reasoning: The cited NFL.com passage gives Elliott's hometown, childhood sports, start in organized football, Memphis honors, and school field-goal record. ESPN reports his conference career records. ESPN also documents his 61-yard game winner and that it was the longest in Eagles history.

excerpts: Elliott [grew up playing tennis and soccer](http://www.chicagotribune.com/suburbs/western-springs/sports/ct-dws-jake-elliott-nfl-draft-kicker-tl-0309-20170307-story.html) in his hometown of Western Springs, Illinois, and did not begin playing organized football until his junior year at Lyons Township High School.

Elliott picked up the art of kicking very quickly and went on to earn first-team All-Conference honors in all four years at Memphis. He also set a school record for the longest field goal in program history (56 yards). After completing his collegiate career, Elliott became the first kicker selected in the fifth round with the 153rd pick. Elliott entered training camp competing for the placekicker job with five-year veteran [Randy Bullock](https://www.nfl.com/player/randybullock/2533444/profile) , a battle Elliott ultimately lost.

excerpts:
> — Jake Elliott (@jake\_elliott22) [September 12, 2017](https://twitter.com/jake_elliott22/status/907656125738373126)

A rookie out of [Memphis](https://www.espn.com/college-football/team/_/id/235/memphis-tigers) , Elliott converted 78 percent of his field goal tries over four seasons at the collegiate level and holds American Athletic Conference records for career points (445) and made field goals (81).

excerpts: Kicker [Jake Elliott](https://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/3050478/jake-elliott) , signed off the [Cincinnati Bengals](https://www.espn.com/nfl/team/_/name/cin/cincinnati-bengals) ' practice squad two weeks ago following an injury to [Caleb Sturgis](https://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/15918/caleb-sturgis) , nailed a 61-yard field goal as time expired to lift the [Philadelphia Eagles](https://www.espn.com/nfl/team/_/name/phi/philadelphia-eagles) to a [27-24 win](https://www.espn.com/nfl/game?gameId=400951616) over the [New York Giants](https://www.espn.com/nfl/team/_/name/nyg/new-york-giants) .

• [2017 schedule, results](http://www.espn.com/nfl/schedule)  
• [Standings](http://www.espn.com/nfl/standings)

Elliott was a fifth-round draft pick by the Bengals.

"I usually don't go out that long during the course of my [pregame] warm-up. I usually go out to 50, 56, maybe 57 and call it a day from there."

His 61-yarder is the longest in Eagles history.
